cs.t: I disabled the lighting on my Keychron Q1 Max due to the battery drain. With it on (on the lowest glow possible), it would barely last a week. With it off? I go literal months without charging it back up, and it's used wirelessly 100% of the time, both via Bluetooth and 2.4 GHz.
cs.th: Industrial design files for Keychron keyboards and mice

cs.t: Love my Keychron Q1 Max. Awesome to see them open source their design files.
